concerns.text: Phase 6 (T051-T054) implements 'molecular hypothesis' generation and 'experimental protocol' design (e.g., Isothermal Titration Calorimetry). This scope is not covered by any Functional Requirement (FR-001 to FR-008) or Success Criterion (SC-001 to SC-005) in spec.md, which strictly limits the project to 'analyzing publicly available datasets' for correlational statistics. The implementer has no authorized task to fulfill the spec's defined scope for this phase.

Tasks T026 (heatmap) and T027 (PCoA plot) are marked as incomplete (unchecked) in the task list. These tasks correspond to FR-005 ('System MUST generate a heatmap... and a PCoA ordination plot'). The absence of completed tasks for these mandatory deliverables means the spec's FR-005 cannot be satisfied.

Task T024 includes a note stating 'Updating spec FR-004... requires a spec amendment (kickback)' but the task itself proceeds with the deviation (using 'diet type' instead of 'diet timing'). While the plan.md acknowledges this, the task description implies the spec is being overridden without a formal amendment record in the current artifact set, creating a traceability gap for the requirement change.

Task T032 includes a note stating 'Updating spec SC-002... requires a spec amendment (kickback)' regarding the acceptance of CIs including zero. Similar to T024, the task implements a logic correction that contradicts the written SC-002 without a visible, formalized spec amendment in the provided artifacts, leaving the requirement traceability incomplete.
